messages:
alex.ae: Quick heads-up — enterprise FinTech customer asked if we can do a seat-based commit model for Private (VPC) instead of our usual platform fee for on‑prem. They want 12-month commit, 50 seats, want reduced monthly platform fee if commit accepted. Need pricing guidance + dealdesk path. Tags: @sam.salesops @mike.solutions
meera.eng: Do we have expected throughput or GPU profile? seat-based can hide capacity needs. Any perf reqs?
alex.ae: Customer will run low-latency chat + embeddings, estimate 600k tokens/day, 8 concurrent streams, peaks ~12 rps. Prefers smaller per-seat charge + cap on total monthly spend. Region: eu-west.
sam.salesops: Depends on commit structure. Two options we usually offer: 1) platform-fee waiver with minimum committed $/mo; 2) split commit (seat commit + platform fee reduced). For 12mo/50 seats ballpark discount could be 20-35%. Need legal/finance to sign off.
danielle.legal: Seat-based licensing modifies MRR recognition and termination terms. We'll need amendment: add seat definition, seat transfer rules, and a minimum usage floor. Also add clause for overage calculation. I'll draft language but need pricing anchor.
mike.solutions: From ops POV, for 50 seats & expected load, recommend Dedicated small pool + KV caching enabled. Support tier: Enterprise Standard (24/7) or Enterprise Plus? For seat-based I'd recommend Enterprise Standard + 4 SLO credits for burst.
alex.ae: Can you put rough numbers? AE needs to put in quote by EOD.
mike.solutions: Rough sketch: per-seat MSRP $400/mo -> 50 seats = $20k/mo. With 12mo commit + 25% discount => $15k/mo. Reduce platform fee from $8k -> $2k/mo. So total ~$17k/mo. If we swap to Dedicated reserved capacity, ops estimate adds $3k/mo infra premium. This is quick calc, not final.
sam.salesops: I'll run this against rate card. Two asks for deal desk: 1) Approve seat-discount band 25% for 12mo 50 seats. 2) Platform fee reduction cap to $2k/mo. @danielle.legal to confirm amendment ok. @finance loop?
danielle.legal: Fine to proceed to draft, but require minimum annual commitment language and audit rights. Need to include standard export-control/KYC if FinTech.
dealbot: DealDesk request created: DD-3421. Approvers: finance@redwood, revenueops@redwood. Link: https://redwood.internal/dealdesk/DD-3421
alex.ae: Thanks — I'll attach POC SOW and customer PO when available. Any blockers to pushing to DealDesk?
sam.salesops: None from SalesOps. Finance will weigh in on effective ARR recognition. @finance please advise.
finance: Can accept 25% discount band if ARR >= $180k. For 12mo we need upfront or net-30 with credit check. Recommend up-front deposit equal to first 3 months.
alex.ae: Great, I'll propose 3mo deposit + 12mo term in quote. Will flag AML/KYC to customer. Thanks team :thumbsup:
meera.eng: One more note: if they actually spike beyond estimate, we should auto-fallback to a higher-capacity SKU during bursts — ops can add auto-burst policy. I'll add line item.
alex.ae: Awesome. I'll submit DD-3421 with the numbers and SOW. End of thread.
